Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
Heard Ms. Garima Singh holding brief of Sri Uttam Kumar Awasthi, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Abhishesh Kumar Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State.

It has been contended by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is in jail since 12.6.2022 in Case Crime No. 242 of 2022 u/s 498A, 304B, 201 I.P.C. & section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.
Khairaghat, District Bahraich.
It has been submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case as he has not committed any offence as alleged.

This Court has passed order dated 10.7.2024 which reads as under :
Dilshad @ Lambu vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. ...

"Heard Ms. Garima Singh, learned Counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

Shri Rajendra Prasad Lodhi, learned Counsel for the informant is not present nor any request for adjournment has been made.
Ms. Garima Singh, learned Counsel for the applicant presses this bail application on the basis of parity saying that the co-accused has been granted bail.
Considering the aforesaid fact, list/put up this case on 15.07.2024 within top 10 cases of the cause list.

Ms. Garima Singh, learned Counsel for the applicant shall intimate the date fixed to learned Counsel for the informant in writing."
Ms. Garima Singh has produced the certified copy of the order-sheet of the learned court-below along with the typed copy of the same, same is taken on record.

Ms. Singh has submitted that she has enclosed the order-sheet to show the Court that the prosecution witnesses are not cooperating with the prosecution, resultant thereof the prosecution is not getting good progress.
She has further submitted that more than two years period has passed in the jail, to be more precise the present applicant is in jail since 12.6.2022.
She has further submitted that the present applicant has been falsely implicated as he has not committed any offence as alleged.
He was having a very cordial and good relation with his wife and in last two years of marriage with the deceased there was no complaint.
Though the cause of death is strangulation and the deceased is having some injuries but those injuries have not been caused by him.
She has further submitted that in the impugned F.I.R. the general allegations have been levelled against all accused persons including the present applicant.

Considering those general allegations this Court granted bail to the father-in-law, Fida Hussain, in Bail Application No. 715 of 2023 vide order dated 13.1.2023 and mother-in-law Smt. Nankat has been granted bail in Bail Application No. 411 of 2023 vide order dated 25.1.2023.

She has further submitted that considering the period of incarceration in jail i.e. more than two years and also considering the fact that the applicant has no criminal history, therefore, the applicant is entitled for bail.

The learned counsel for the applicant has given an undertaking on behalf of applicant that the applicant shall not misuse the liberty of bail and shall cooperate with the trial proceedings and shall abide by all terms and conditions of bail, if granted.

Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail by submitting that the mother-in-law and father-in-law have been granted bail but the responsibility of the present applicant is more serious than the father-in-law and mother-in-law, therefore, the bail may be rejected.

Without entering into the merits of the case and considering the arguments of learned counsel for the parties, contents and allegations of the F.I.R., the fact that the prosecution witnesses are not Dilshad @ Lambu vs State Of U.P. Nankat has been granted bail in Bail Appliation No. 411 of 2023 vide order dated 25.1.2023, the period of incarceration in jail i.e. more than two years and also considering the fact that the applicant has no criminal history, and the undertaking given on behalf of the applicant that he shall not misuse the liberty of bail and shall cooperate in the trial proceedings, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in this case.

sentences.text:
Let the applicant Dilshad @ Lambu, involved in aforesaid case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation,
then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law,
under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.
( v) The applicant shall not leave the country without permission of the Court concerned.

. 
(Rajesh Singh Chauhan, J.) Order Date :- 15.7.2024
